entries.claim: Qualified ministers at least in the diaconate recite Munda and request the celebrant's blessing. Submissa voce immediately modifies recitant and naturally extends in context to the conjoined request, without a separately repeated request label. The celebrant explicitly responds media voce. Et illi dicunt assigns Amen to the ministers, without a separate Amen voice label. No app enum equivalence is established.
